data.gender_notes: Rubab is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes peace and serenity, bringing calmness to those around. The name Rubab carries the meaning “Bringer of peace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rubab usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reflects the concept of Islam, promoting inner peace and harmony.
data.etymology: Rubab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rubab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: رُباب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث، يعني الرقة و العلو و الرفعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: رُباب هو اسم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'رَبَبتُ' أي علا وارتفع. يعني الرقة و العلو و الرفعة. وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 2، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَهُوَ الَّذِيَ أَرْسَلَ الرِّياحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَي رَحْمَتِهِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهِرًا'، وقد استخدم في الشعر العربي لوصف الجمال و العلو.

in_urdu.name: روباب
in_urdu.long_meaning: روباب ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے روشنائی، رقت، علو اور بلندیاں۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں بہت مقبول ہے۔ اس نام کی اصیل عربی جڑیں ہیں اور یہ قرآن مجید میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रूबाब
in_hindi.long_meaning: रूबाब एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है रोशनाई, रकत, उन्नति और उच्चता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर बच्चियों को दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: روباب
in_pashto.long_meaning: روباب د ښځینه نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د روښنايي، رقت، علو او لوړوالی معنی لري. دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو او نورو مسلمانانو تر منځ ډیر مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Rubab
in_english.long_meaning: Rubab is a beautiful and meaningful name of Arabic origin. It signifies brilliance, elevation, beauty, and nobility. The name has been mentioned in the Quran and has a rich history in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes spiritual growth, moral excellence, and refinement. In modern times, the name Rubab is popular across various Muslim cultures, reflecting its timeless significance and appeal.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Rubab holds great significance as it is derived from the Arabic word "rubaba," which means "to rest," "to cause to rest," or "to bring peace." Historically, the name was believed to be given to infants as a wish for a peaceful and tranquil life, symbolizing comfort and calmness for those around them. In some communities, the name is also associated with the Rubab, a traditional musical instrument resembling a lute, further emphasizing the sense of peace and serenity it brings.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Rubab represents a profound connection to the divine, embodying the qualities of peace, tranquility, and calmness. As stated in verses from the Holy Quran, "And remind them of the Day when the Reaper shall take them while they are in their main occupation, their ears and their eyes will be turned away from Him." (AL-GHAASHIYAH 88:1). Rubab's spiritual significance lies in the reminder of the importance of spiritual reflection and seeking closeness to Allah through constant peace and tranquility. It is a reminder for individuals to find stillness in their hearts and minds, despite the external distractions, wearing the name as a daily source of inner peace and devotion.
